label: Tasks
empty_hint: No proposed or awaiting-steer tasks for this machine.

actions.label: View card
actions.description: Read the full card a blocked worker posted (title/status/link/body). Read-only.

actions.label: Steer — answer the card
actions.description: Read the card and answer its questions (any shape), then wake the worker. Never a verdict — the operator's steer, not an ADO vote.

actions.label: Open into a CLI session
actions.description: Open this task's target worktree into a Copilot CLI session (resume /resume-handoff there to consume a handoff).

actions.label: Kick to a headless bridge agent
actions.description: Spawn a background bridge agent on this machine to work the task.
